help.title: Help
help.subtitle: A short guide, step by step.
help.intro: Mirrorbase copies a database from a saved source to a saved target. Follow the steps in order the first time; later you only need Replicate.

databases.question: Which databases are supported?
databases.answer: PostgreSQL and SQLite. Every database type is a plugin, so more types can follow.

mixed.question: Can I copy from PostgreSQL to SQLite?
mixed.answer: Not yet. Source and target must be the same type. Copying between types is planned.

forgotPin.question: I forgot my PIN.
forgotPin.answer: Choose Forgot PIN on the lock screen. The app unlocks, but every saved password is erased and you enter them again.

data.question: Where is my data?
data.answer: Saved connections, the log and the settings are stored on this computer. Passwords are encrypted and the key is kept in the system keychain.

overwrite.question: Does a copy overwrite the target?
overwrite.answer: Only if you tick “Replace databases that already exist on the target”. Without it, a database that exists already is skipped with an error.

pin.title: Protect the app with a PIN
pin.purpose: The PIN is the only protection. It locks the app when you start it, when you are away and when the computer locks.

steps.setPin: On first start, choose a PIN of 4 to 8 digits and repeat it.
steps.lock: Choose Lock now in the navigation to lock the app at any time.
steps.change: Change the PIN or the idle time in Settings. You need the current PIN.

tips.autoLock: The idle time can be set from 1 to 240 minutes.
tips.forgot: Forgetting the PIN erases all saved passwords.

connections.title: Save your databases
connections.purpose: A connection stores where a database lives, so you do not enter it every time.

steps.add: Choose New connection, give it a name and pick the database type.
steps.test: Fill in the fields the type asks for and test the connection, as source or as target.
steps.save: Save. The connection now appears in the lists of Replicate.
steps.group: Optionally enter a group. Connections with the same group are listed together.

tips.password: Passwords are saved encrypted and never appear in the log.
tips.docker: For a Docker database you can also pick the container on the Replicate page.

replicate.title: Copy a database
replicate.purpose: Pick a saved source and a saved target, then start the copy.

steps.pickSource: Under Source, choose the connection to copy from. For a server with several databases, tick the ones to copy.
steps.pickTarget: Under Target, choose where the copy goes.
steps.start: Choose the copy button and confirm. Progress shows below.
steps.cancel: Choose Cancel to stop a run that is in progress.

tips.sameType: Source and target must be the same kind of database (PostgreSQL or SQLite, local or in Docker).
tips.overwrite: Tick “Replace databases that already exist on the target” only when you want the target replaced.

docker.title: Use a running Docker database
docker.purpose: Databases running in Docker on this computer can be picked without typing their address.

steps.list: Choose From Docker to list the containers that are running now.
steps.pick: Pick one to fill in its address and port. Add the user and password.
steps.start: A stopped container is started for you when you save its connection, list its databases or start a copy.

tips.dockerRunning: Docker must be running. If it is not, the list says so.

dockerTarget.title: Copy into a new Docker database
dockerTarget.purpose: Mirrorbase can create the Docker container for the copy itself, from an image you choose.

steps.create: Choose New connection and pick the type PostgreSQL (Docker) or SQLite (Docker).
steps.fill: Enter a container name, the image (for example postgres:16) and, for PostgreSQL, a port and a password.
steps.test: Test the connection as target: it says that the container will be created. Save.
steps.copy: On Replicate, choose this connection as target and start the copy. The container is created and started on the first run.

tips.dockerRunning: Docker must be running. The first run downloads the image, which can take a while.
tips.sameKind: The source must be of the same kind: PostgreSQL (also Docker) into PostgreSQL (Docker), SQLite into SQLite (Docker).

updates.title: Update the app
updates.purpose: Mirrorbase looks for new versions on GitHub and installs them on request.

steps.check: Open Settings and choose Check for updates. The app also checks a few seconds after it starts.
steps.install: When a version is available, choose Download, then Restart and install.

tips.mac: On macOS the app cannot update itself yet: Settings links to the releases page.

log.title: Read the log
log.purpose: Every run is recorded, with each step and any error.

steps.open: Open Log to see the messages of the app and of every run.
steps.select: Select a run to see only its messages.

tips.secrets: Passwords are hidden in the log.

transfer.title: Back up or move connections
transfer.purpose: Export your connections to a file and import them again, e.g. on another computer.

steps.export: Choose Export. Tick “Include the saved passwords” only if you need them in the file.
steps.password: Passwords are only exported encrypted: choose an export password. You can also encrypt a file without passwords.
steps.import: Choose Import, pick the file and enter its password if it is encrypted.

tips.encrypted: Keep the export password safe: without it the file cannot be read.
tips.names: A connection whose name already exists is imported with a number appended. Nothing is overwritten.

support.title: Like Mirrorbase?
support.text: It is free. If it saves you time, you can buy me a coffee.
